expected.note: No prediction available. These are published results from the cited papers, not predictions.

options.conditions: As measured in the study: first soak 15 min at 30 C, manual dehulling, second soak 45 min at 30 C, wet milling, deep frying 190 C for 12 min. Each stage is cumulative from raw seed. Four cowpea varieties; means of three households. Do not read these as the effect of frying alone.
options.evidence: published rows, same crop, one study, 12 rows; cumulative stages (soak + dehull + soak + mill + fry)
options.instruction: Soak the beans briefly, then remove the skins (dehull). Soak the skinned beans again. Wet-mill to a paste. Fry the paste fully (akara).

options.conditions: As measured in the study: soak 15 min, dehull, soak 45 min at 30 C, wet mill, steam 105 C for 35 min. Cumulative from raw seed. Four varieties.
options.evidence: published rows, same crop, one study, 12 rows; cumulative stages
options.instruction: Soak the beans briefly, then remove the skins. Soak again, then wet-mill to a paste. Steam the paste fully.

options.conditions: As measured in the study: dehulled seed pressure cooked at 105 C for 45 min. Cumulative from raw seed. Four varieties.
options.evidence: published rows, same crop, one study, 12 rows; cumulative stages
options.instruction: Soak briefly and remove the skins. Pressure-cook the beans until fully soft.

options.conditions: As measured in the study (makinde2020): dehulled seed boiled 100 C for 20 min, oven-dried 60 C, milled. Three genotype rows per metric.
options.evidence: published rows, same crop, one study, 21 rows
options.instruction: Soak briefly and remove the skins. Boil until fully soft. Dry and mill to flour.

options.conditions: Bolade 2015: 15 min soak, dehull, 45 min soak at 30 C (cumulative from raw). Abiodun 2011: dehulled and soaked 30 min, oven-dried, milled.
options.evidence: published rows, same crop, 2 studies, 34 rows; includes Bolade cumulative stages
options.instruction: Soak the beans briefly. Remove the skins by hand. Soak again if the recipe needs a paste.

options.conditions: As measured in the study (makinde2020): about 20 min in a pan, temperature not otherwise stated, oven-dried 60 C, milled.
options.evidence: published rows, same crop, one study, 21 rows
options.instruction: Soak briefly and remove the skins. Roast in a pan, stirring. Cool and mill to flour.

options.conditions: As measured in the study (kewuyemi2024): germination 35 C for 48 h; or probiotic mixed-culture fermentation 35 C for 48 h. Whole beans, not dehulled. One value per metric.
options.evidence: published rows, same crop, one study, 4 rows
options.instruction: Germinate whole beans, or ferment the milled whole-bean flour.

options.evidence: published rows, same crop, 4 rows, 1 paper(s); cumulative stages from raw seed, not the effect of this step alone
